verdict.rationale: Source availability under an open license is a fair question for an AI model or API product, so the axis applies. The pack shows no open-licensed source or weights for the GPT API or its models. The only GitHub item (gpt-gh-1) describes a client SDK that accesses the hosted REST API, and it states no license, so it is at most adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
